# Soft Home Global

> Soft Home Global is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) and medical billing
> company. Trained back-office teams work 22 roles — denial management,
> AR follow-up, prior authorization, credentialing — for US practices across all
> 50 states, priced per seat per month with a one-month minimum and no
> percentage-of-collections take. This file indexes every page; the answers
> themselves are in https://softhomeglobal.com/llms-full.txt.

## Pricing summary

- Certified payroll specialist: $1,600 per seat per month
- AR caller / denials: $1,700 per seat per month
- Eligibility & benefits: $1,700 per seat per month
- Prior authorization: $1,900 per seat per month
- Credentialing: $2,200 per seat per month
- Certified coder: $2,500 per seat per month
- Payment posting: $1,500 per seat per month
- Charge entry & claim submission: $1,500 per seat per month
